There is a device called a KVM switch.

It's a switch that flips your Keyboard, Video and Mouse from one computer to another. You don't have to connect all three, so you could conceivably leave both monitors running and just switch from one to the other.

This is a wired solution but it may be your most robust choice. I deeply distrust most software based approaches to this system, as I've been stuck without keyboard or mouse access to a box before.
